title: A closing single quote on its own line needs the indentation of the scalar's continuation lines
notes: The entry is in a block sequence at indentation 0, so a continuation line needs at least 1 space of indentation (production 69), and that includes a line that holds only the closing quote. The quote at line 2, column 1 is the first character that cannot belong.

provenance.reference: A reader that checked the indentation of continuation lines but not of the line with the closing quote.
